telegrive.description:
Your Telegram account as an unlimited drive, with automatic photo backup.
Use your Telegram account as a drive with no storage limit, and back up your photos to it.

Telegrive keeps your files in a private channel in your own Telegram account and gives you a simple file manager for them. There is no new account to make and no Telegrive server: you sign in with Telegram, and your files stay in Telegram.
